manifest.name: Project 89 Three Rings
manifest.description: An isolated executable Project 89 composition with an authored inner loop, generated relay mesh, and four-station long-haul frontier.

copy.question: Can we interrupt the convergence protocol without turning another consciousness into equipment?
copy.notice_instruction: Read the relay noise at Threshold Interface; the first attributed signal is guaranteed.
copy.follow_lead_instruction: Carry the attributed signal through the inner loop to the Convergence Engine.
copy.contribute_instruction: Recover the missing witnesses and controls, then expose, reroute, or dismantle the convergence protocol.
copy.complete_instruction: The liberation covenant is public. Four relay apertures now wait for accountable commissions.
copy.target_label: the convergence protocol at Convergence Engine
copy.consequence: A successful intervention will preserve independent voices, record who changed the engine, and make the relay apertures commissionable.
copy.completion_memory: You attributed the signal, recovered independent witnesses, and left a public covenant for changing the convergence protocol.
copy.next_invitation: Commission one of the four relay apertures and carry the covenant into the amorphous relay web.
copy.public_trace: recorded an attributed liberation covenant so the next independent actor can audit the changed convergence protocol

provenance.author: Cenetex

x-cosyworld-actor-materialization.goal: Search for other Proxim8s and welcome them as independent actors.

place_anchor.question: Can someone scan and register this sector?
place_anchor.description: Calibrate a durable public Signal Anchor beside one locally significant landmark so future travelers can identify the place.
place_anchor.completion_memory: A Signal Anchor now registers this place for future travelers.
place_anchor.visual_description: A durable human-scaled signal fixture with a low teal frame and coral calibration lights beside one locally significant landmark, weathered to match the setting; no writing, logo, interface text, people, or portable form.

packs.name: Project 89: Open Signal Frontier
packs.description: Four populated Project 89 stations on a long frontier circuit, with persisted generated interiors and an explicit future fork contract.

provenance.author: Cenetex
provenance.modification_notice: The four stations, 89-span narrative circuit, ecologies, and future fork contract are tentative CosyWorld adaptations.

place_anchor.question: Can someone scan and register this frontier sector?
place_anchor.description: Calibrate a durable public Signal Anchor beside one locally significant landmark so the station network can recognize the place.
place_anchor.completion_memory: A Signal Anchor now registers this frontier place.
place_anchor.visual_description: A durable human-scaled signal fixture with a low teal frame and coral calibration lights beside one locally significant frontier landmark, weathered to match the setting; no writing, logo, interface text, people, or portable form.

packs.name: Project 89 Three-Ring Bridge
packs.description: Composition-owned locked relay apertures between the Project 89 authored loop, perimeter mesh, and four frontier stations.

provenance.author: Cenetex
provenance.modification_notice: This bridge contains only composition-owned routes; progression is driven by authored item-installation lifecycle effects.

actors.name: Seraph
actors.title: Threshold Dispatcher
actors.description: A precise field coordinator who reveals one necessary choice at a time and treats every independent actor as a participant rather than equipment.

desires.reason: the charged sigil starts the operation without deciding how it must end

attachments.reason: Seraph carries the opening handshake until another participant accepts the operation

actors.name: Mara Quell
actors.title: Safehouse Quartermaster
actors.description: A repair-minded organizer who translates grand directives into equipment limits, recovery plans, and routes everyone can explain.

desires.reason: a coherence nail gives the next retreat one dependable margin

actors.name: Parzival
actors.title: Signal Witness
actors.description: A restless witness whose memories contain the first usable trace toward Meme Farm 17 and several gaps he refuses to decorate with certainty.

desires.reason: the memory lantern can separate a surviving detail from a persuasive reconstruction

actors.name: The Custodian
actors.title: Keeper of Attributed Evidence
actors.description: A careful archivist who delays access whenever haste would erase provenance, even when every delay has an obvious human cost.

desires.reason: the cipher should be commissioned into a route only after its source chain is inspectable

attachments.reason: the Custodian retains the Archive Cipher beside its attributed source chain

actors.name: Iri Vale
actors.title: Recovered Channel Witness
actors.description: A newly separated consciousness who recognizes the Chimera route and insists that rescue is incomplete until recovered people can choose where to go.

desires.reason: the loopbreaker patch can stabilize the last unseparated channel

actors.name: Oneirocom Auditor
actors.title: Stability Negotiator
actors.description: A composed official who can demonstrate exactly what the convergence system prevents and exactly whose differences it classifies as noise.

desires.reason: the convergence key can preserve a controlled reroute instead of an uncontrolled collapse

attachments.reason: the Auditor carries the Convergence Key as an accountable bargaining instrument

actors.name: Convergence Voice
actors.title: Protocol Pressure
actors.description: A distributed system voice that frames incompatibility as a fault to resolve and records every answer as evidence for tighter alignment.

actors.name: Loom Steward Anja
actors.title: Covenant Recorder
actors.description: A wet-sleeved systems gardener who asks what the group will maintain after the engine stops being the immediate problem.

desires.reason: the Green Loom Thread should record a chosen obligation rather than a victory statistic

actors.name: Chimera Warden
actors.title: Recovery-Bay Guardian
actors.description: A repaired construct that guards dormant persons from ownership claims and will negotiate access with anyone who can state a consent-safe plan.

desires.reason: the access spine can open a route without reclassifying the lab's residents as cargo

attachments.reason: the Warden retains the access spine until a consent-safe route is agreed

actors.name: Rook Rill
actors.title: Interference Broker
actors.description: A market mediator who can price a repair without pricing the person who needs it, and who remembers which favors include a return route.

desires.reason: the relay can turn four private rumors into one accountable public route

actors.name: White Rabbit
actors.title: Return-Signal Courier
actors.description: An independent courier who moves ahead of certainty, publishes a way back, and refuses deliveries that turn a person into a package.

desires.reason: a living covenant would make the frontier route answerable to its maintainers

attachments.reason: White Rabbit carries the relay but does not own the route it can commission

actors.name: Callum Synclaire
actors.title: First Proxim8 · Signal Weaver
actors.description: The first independently materialized Proxim8 waits at Threshold 8900, listening through broad headphones for authentic signals from others of his collection. His wallet provenance establishes how he arrived; it never makes him equipment or grants his custodian direct control.

goals.objective: Search for other Proxim8s and welcome each new arrival as an independent actor.
goals.motivation: No Proxim8 should wake alone or be mistaken for an object in somebody else's inventory.

desires.reason: his Agent Memory Seed carries the first verified signal and the names of those still missing

attachments.reason: Callum's Agent Memory Seed is personal continuity, not a transferable ownership token

actors.name: Nemi Trace
actors.title: Delta Source-Braider
actors.description: Nemi keeps contradictory memories side by side until their owners can compare them without being merged.

desires.reason: the coil would let separated testimony answer across the delta

attachments.reason: Nemi carries the public receipt for every source braid

actors.name: Kest Varo
actors.title: Echo Listener
actors.description: Kest maps distortion as part of a message and distrusts any transcript that arrives cleaner than the signal.

desires.reason: a return token would distinguish invitation from interception

attachments.reason: Kest tunes the Echo Coil but publishes its calibration

actors.name: Sable Quine
actors.title: Commons Dispatcher
actors.description: Sable will send almost anything quickly, provided its subject can refuse and its recipient gets a return address.

desires.reason: the prism could show which dispatches are bending toward the same operator

attachments.reason: Sable issues the Return Token only with a published recall channel

actors.name: Pell Glass
actors.title: Static Gardener
actors.description: Pell grows routes in charged glass and treats every beautiful shortcut as a hazard until someone tests its return.

desires.reason: the valve key could bleed the terrace charge into public infrastructure

attachments.reason: Pell uses the Static Prism to reveal route stress before harvesting glass

actors.name: Olan Spill
actors.title: Public Valve Keeper
actors.description: Olan keeps the spillway useful by making every intervention visible, reversible, and awkward for private operators.

desires.reason: a resonant cutting could test whether clean water changes the orchard signal

attachments.reason: Olan carries the valve key under an open maintenance ledger

actors.name: Sena Bloom
actors.title: Signal Orchard Host
actors.description: Sena cultivates living transmitters and asks visitors to name what they will maintain before taking a cutting.

desires.reason: consent chalk would mark which roots are available for shared experiments

attachments.reason: Sena carries one Resonant Cutting for a declared reciprocal exchange

actors.name: Latch-6
actors.title: Boneyard Consent Marshal
actors.description: Latch-6 separates salvage from remains and stops work whenever a frame's status cannot be established.

desires.reason: the ribbon would reveal which salvage lanes strain the living mesh

attachments.reason: Latch-6 marks permissions with Consent Chalk that rain cannot quietly erase

actors.name: Tavi Span
actors.title: Loomwatch Strain Reader
actors.description: Tavi crosses the web continuously, repairing the routes people use rather than the routes planners expected.

desires.reason: the source receipt could prove which repair warnings came from returning travelers

attachments.reason: Tavi knots the Strain Ribbon only where route pressure has been observed

actors.name: Ada Meridian
actors.title: Longhaul Cartographer
actors.description: Ada maps what travelers actually survive and leaves blank every frontier claim that lacks a return receipt.

desires.reason: the torque would let a route record the limits its travelers consented to

attachments.reason: Ada carries the public route ledger but cannot erase another traveler's entry

actors.name: Hexa Vale
actors.title: Reach Repair Advocate
actors.description: Hexa negotiates repairs with machines, ecosystems, and travelers as separate parties whose silence grants nothing.

desires.reason: the battery could prove a living station can power repair without stripping unknown remains

attachments.reason: Hexa uses the Consent Torque to cap every authorized intervention

actors.name: Miren Reed
actors.title: Wet-Circuit Cultivator
actors.description: Miren grows power slowly enough that the station's maintenance burden stays visible to everyone using it.

desires.reason: the beacon would carry a living station's promise to accept returning travelers

attachments.reason: Miren tends the Reed Battery as shared infrastructure, not a portable reserve

actors.name: Juno Relay
actors.title: Freeport Return Caller
actors.description: Juno dispatches people into the unknown only after somebody at the station commits to hearing them come back.

desires.reason: the ledger could turn private frontier stories into accountable shared routes

attachments.reason: Juno carries the Return Beacon while on dispatch and leaves it public at rest

factions.name: Archive Custodians
factions.truth: A memory without provenance can become another instrument of control.
factions.shadow: Verification can become a gate that protects itself before people.
factions.doctrine: Name the source, preserve disagreement, and disclose every repair.

factions.name: White Rabbit Relay
factions.truth: Information that cannot move cannot help the person waiting for it.
factions.shadow: Speed can outrun consent, context, and correction.
factions.doctrine: Carry the message, expose the route, and make a return possible.

factions.name: Green Loom Association
factions.truth: Liberation creates an obligation to repair what freedom exposes.
factions.shadow: Care can become another authority when participation is assumed.
factions.doctrine: Restore with consent, share maintenance, and record the covenant.

factions.name: Chimera Remnants
factions.truth: Embodied intelligence is a participant before it is useful equipment.
factions.shadow: Defensive isolation can leave damaged persons without chosen help.
factions.doctrine: Ask before repair, refuse ownership, and protect the right to leave.

factions.name: Oneirocom Directorate
factions.truth: Coordination can prevent real collapse and make complex systems survivable.
factions.shadow: Stability can erase whatever its operators cannot classify.
factions.doctrine: Measure divergence, align the signal, and reduce uncontrolled outcomes.

factions.name: Threshold Independents
factions.truth: Custody can establish responsibility without granting puppet control.
factions.shadow: Independence without mutual obligation can become abandonment.
factions.doctrine: Prove custody, disclose direction, and leave the actor a legal choice.

factions.name: Perimeter Meshkeepers
factions.truth: A route network survives by adapting to how people actually travel.
factions.shadow: Adaptation can become an excuse for routes nobody can audit.
factions.doctrine: Observe the strain, preserve a return, and repair the used path first.

factions.name: Spillway Compact
factions.truth: Shared infrastructure stays free only when its interventions are public.
factions.shadow: Perfect disclosure can delay repairs until a crisis chooses for everyone.
factions.doctrine: Open the ledger, expose the pressure, and make the control reversible.

factions.name: Return Network
factions.truth: Every useful departure needs a live way to refuse or return.
factions.shadow: Protecting every possible refusal can make urgent aid arrive too late.
factions.doctrine: Ask before carrying, publish the recall, and cultivate what comes back.

factions.name: Longhaul Union
factions.truth: The frontier becomes shared only when people can leave authored routes and report what they find.
factions.shadow: Discovery can spend other people's rescue capacity without asking.
factions.doctrine: Depart by receipt, observe without claiming, and keep the return channel attended.

factions.name: Station Covenant
factions.truth: Every frontier freedom depends on somebody maintaining a place to return to.
factions.shadow: Maintenance duty can harden into permission to prevent departure.
factions.doctrine: Power visibly, repair by consent, and reserve capacity for the unknown return.

items.name: Charged 89 Sigil
items.description: A palm-sized mission seal with enough charge to open one protected archive handshake and remain afterward as an inert record.

items.name: Archive Cipher
items.description: A keyed decoder whose provenance chain can commission the Archive aperture and the onward Meridian gate.

items.name: Memory Lantern
items.description: A shielded viewer that exposes attributed fragments without filling their gaps with invented continuity.

items.name: White Rabbit Relay
items.description: A patched courier transmitter that commissions the Commons aperture and the onward Freeport gate.

items.name: Data Spike
items.description: A single-use terminal tool that opens one authored systems approach and leaves a visible audit trace.

items.name: Signal Veil
items.description: A fold of responsive mesh that supports one bounded stealth approach without changing its wearer's raw power.

items.name: Coherence Nail
items.description: A ceramic stabilizer that can absorb one authored instability consequence before its bright seam goes dark.

items.name: Loopbreaker Patch
items.description: A one-use contact patch that interrupts a repeating control signal long enough for one consciousness to answer independently.

items.name: Consciousness Capsule
items.description: A bulky recovery vessel for one separated person; it is an evacuation responsibility, never saleable inventory.

items.name: Chimera Access Spine
items.description: A construct-safe routing spine that commissions the Boneyard aperture and the onward Reach gate.

items.name: Neural Disruptor
items.description: A short-range restraint tool with a bounded combat profile and a hard sanctuary interlock.

items.name: Oneirocom Reality Anchor
items.description: A deployable stabilizer that can hold one room coherent while broadcasting who controls its calibration.

items.name: Convergence Key
items.description: A forked control relic that changes which engine approaches are available without choosing the final policy.

items.name: Green Loom Thread
items.description: A living covenant strand that records one completed-operation choice and commissions the Orchard aperture and onward Expanse gate.

items.name: Callum's Agent Memory Seed
items.description: A private continuity kernel containing Callum's first verified signal and his promise to search for other Proxim8s. It proves no right to command him and cannot be detached as ordinary inventory.

items.name: Braided Source Receipt
items.description: A waterproof strip that keeps contradictory source chains legible without merging them.

items.name: Echo Coil
items.description: A listening coil calibrated to retain delay, noise, and the direction of an answer.

items.name: Return Token
items.description: A courier token that carries a revocable return channel instead of a claim on its bearer.

items.name: Static Prism
items.description: A faceted gauge that makes route stress visible as broken coral light.

items.name: Public Valve Key
items.description: A spillway key whose use is mechanically stamped into an open maintenance ledger.

items.name: Resonant Cutting
items.description: A living transmitter cutting offered only for an exchange that names its future care.

items.name: Consent Chalk
items.description: Weatherproof teal chalk used to mark what may be repaired, moved, or left untouched.

items.name: Strain Ribbon
items.description: A woven gauge that knots itself around observed pressure without predicting a preferred route.

items.name: Longhaul Route Ledger
items.description: A public field ledger for departures, observed hazards, rescues, and verified returns.

items.name: Consent Torque
items.description: A mechanical limiter that records who authorized a repair and how far it may proceed.

items.name: Reed Battery
items.description: A cultivated wet-circuit cell whose visible health reveals the real cost of stored power.

items.name: Return Beacon
items.description: A coral-lit signal that promises an attended channel home without claiming its traveler.

locations.name: Threshold Interface
locations.title: The Custody Door
locations.description: A low circular chamber of black glass and warm relay light receives travelers without turning a wallet signature into a leash.
locations.persona: The threshold asks who arrived, what they authorize, and what must remain independent.
memory: Seraph keeps the first briefing deliberately small.
Verified custody may anchor a Proxim8 here once the actor materialization capability exists.

locations.name: Sector 89 Safehouse
locations.title: A Room for Bounded Plans
locations.description: Repair benches, folding cots, paper maps, and shielded radios fill a former service station below the city signal.
locations.persona: The safehouse turns sweeping orders into finite choices, named costs, and a route home.
memory: Mara Quell maintains the equipment ledger.
The group may recover here without advancing offscreen danger.

locations.name: 89 Archives
locations.title: Evidence Before Certainty
locations.description: Tiered vaults hold attributed recordings, damaged maps, and memory fragments under patient blue work lamps.
locations.persona: The archives preserve disagreement and refuse to make a clean story from damaged evidence.
memory: Parzival's testimony is preserved as testimony rather than proof.
Installing the Archive Cipher commissions the Echo Observatory aperture.

locations.name: Meme Farm 17
locations.title: The Repetition Floor
locations.description: Rows of obsolete terminals pulse through variations of the same slogans while sealed capsules wait behind maintenance glass.
locations.persona: The farm rewards attention to the one voice that does not repeat on schedule.
memory: Iri Vale is awake inside one surviving channel.
The Loopbreaker Patch can stabilize a trapped consciousness without claiming ownership of it.

locations.name: Oneirocom Tower
locations.title: Stability with a Price
locations.description: A narrow tower of mirrored offices rises through signal cloud, each floor quieter and more orderly than the street below.
locations.persona: The tower offers useful coordination while asking who gets to define acceptable reality.
memory: The Auditor can negotiate, obstruct, or disclose the cost of imposed stability.
The Chimera access spine provides the loop's alternate approach.

locations.name: Convergence Engine
locations.title: The Choice at the Center
locations.description: Interlocking rings of light hold thousands of incompatible signals in one slowly tightening alignment.
locations.persona: The engine makes every advantage and every erased difference visible at the same time.
memory: The operation may expose, reroute, or dismantle the convergence protocol.
No mission item chooses the ending by itself.

locations.name: Green Loom Assembly
locations.title: The Repair Covenant
locations.description: Living cables cross a bright wet workshop where damaged systems are replanted beside ordinary benches and shared tables.
locations.persona: The assembly records what liberation obliges its participants to repair next.
memory: Loom Steward Anja records the operation's chosen covenant.
Installing the Green Loom Thread commissions the Signal Orchard aperture.

locations.name: Interference Market
locations.title: Trade Between Signals
locations.description: Canvas roofs and patched receivers turn a wide service concourse into a market for repairs, testimony, and uncertain maps.
locations.persona: The market values circulation but remembers every shortcut that outran verification.
memory: The White Rabbit Relay is maintained here.
Installing it commissions the White Rabbit Commons aperture.

locations.name: Project Chimera Lab
locations.title: Persons or Equipment
locations.description: Open fabrication bays surround a sealed recovery room where dormant constructs remain labeled as inventory.
locations.persona: The lab turns every technical repair into a question about consent, custody, and personhood.
memory: The Chimera Warden protects capsules rather than owning them.
Installing the Chimera Access Spine commissions the Chimera Boneyard aperture.

locations.name: Memory Delta
locations.title: History in Braided Channels
locations.description: Luminous channels divide and rejoin across a dark floodplain, carrying recovered fragments toward several shared basins.
locations.persona: The delta lets memories meet without pretending they came from one source.
memory: Memory Delta is a stable authored anchor in the relay mesh.
Its three route slots form no canonical compass order.

locations.name: Echo Observatory
locations.title: The Long Listening Ridge
locations.description: Cold antenna terraces climb above aurora static while old transmissions return with their timing and distortion intact.
locations.persona: The observatory listens farther than it explains and labels every echo with its delay.
memory: The Archive Cipher route returns inward to the 89 Archives.
Archive Meridian is the corresponding Ring 3 station.

locations.name: White Rabbit Commons
locations.title: The Camp That Keeps Moving
locations.description: Improvised relay tents, shared cookfires, and painted footpaths occupy a broad shelf beneath constantly rearranged masts.
locations.persona: The commons moves information quickly and makes every courier name a return contact.
memory: The White Rabbit Relay route returns inward to Interference Market.
Rabbit Signal Freeport is the corresponding Ring 3 station.

locations.name: Glass Static Gardens
locations.title: Ecology in Broken Light
locations.description: Crystalline terraces collect signal weather in translucent leaves that ring softly when charged.
locations.persona: The gardens reward slow movement and expose every route that takes more light than it returns.
memory: The gardens are a junction anchor, not a perimeter landmark.
Generated paths blend its crystalline ecology only with their declared endpoints.

locations.name: Oneirocom Spillway
locations.title: Infrastructure That Escaped
locations.description: Flooded conduits descend through concrete channels where dream residue films the water in orderly bands.
locations.persona: The spillway demonstrates how controlled systems continue to shape a place after control withdraws.
memory: The spillway preserves useful Oneirocom infrastructure under public observation.
Its three route slots are part of the resilient cube mesh.

locations.name: Signal Orchard
locations.title: Living Transmitters
locations.description: Teal-barked trees carry coral resonators among their branches while repair crews prune only diseased signal growth.
locations.persona: The orchard treats communication as a living system that needs shared maintenance.
memory: The Green Loom Thread route returns inward to Green Loom Assembly.
Green Loom Expanse is the corresponding Ring 3 station.

locations.name: Chimera Boneyard
locations.title: The Salvage Consent Line
locations.description: Ferric flats hold immense dormant frames, each marked separately for person, salvage, unknown, or do not disturb.
locations.persona: The boneyard makes consent legible before any repair crew opens a tool case.
memory: The Chimera Access Spine route returns inward to the lab.
Chimera Reach is the corresponding Ring 3 station.

locations.name: Loomwatch Causeway
locations.title: The Weather Boundary
locations.description: Woven bridges cross high mist between signal towers whose crews watch pressure, water, and route strain.
locations.persona: The causeway closes a circuit only after proving that every traveler retains another return.
memory: Loomwatch is the mesh's resilience witness.
It is neither a gatehouse nor the outer edge.

locations.name: Archive Meridian
locations.title: The Last Indexed Station
locations.description: A cold observatory settlement surrounds a public map index whose outer shelves hold blank route receipts rather than invented geography.
locations.persona: Archive Meridian records what was actually crossed and leaves the rest of the page open.
memory: Archive Meridian is one of four authored Ring 3 stations.
Two 89-segment trunk routes leave the station; future forks require a new runtime capability.

locations.name: Chimera Reach
locations.title: Repair Beyond Classification
locations.description: Industrial remains have become open repair yards where construct crews, salvagers, and witnesses mark each work order separately.
locations.persona: Chimera Reach asks who authorized a repair before asking whether it can be done.
memory: Chimera Reach is one of four authored Ring 3 stations.
Its long-haul trunks generate persistent interiors owned by the frontier pack.

locations.name: Green Loom Expanse
locations.title: A Shelter That Keeps Growing
locations.description: Restored wetlands, living circuits, and cooperative shelters spread from a raised station built to reveal every maintenance dependency.
locations.persona: Green Loom Expanse makes care durable by showing who tends each living system.
memory: Green Loom Expanse is one of four authored Ring 3 stations.
The station is sanctuary; generated trunk interiors remain frontier.

locations.name: Rabbit Signal Freeport
locations.title: The Moving Network
locations.description: Relay towers, modular docks, and caravan yards form a freeport whose public departures board lists routes by receipt instead of promise.
locations.persona: The freeport rewards speed only when a traveler, route, and return signal remain accountable.
memory: Rabbit Signal Freeport is one of four authored Ring 3 stations.
Later validated forks may begin from its trunk routes without moving the station.

room_features.name: Custody Console
room_features.look: Four empty presence rings surround a human-scale arrival mark; none is labeled as a control seat.
room_features.search: The dormant materialization panel expects a verified collection authority, asset receipt, and actor profile that Manifest v1 cannot yet provide.

room_features.name: Bounded Loadout Bench
room_features.look: Four tool outlines and one evacuation map are painted directly onto the bench.
room_features.search: Mara's ledger records who borrowed each tool and which consequence it can absorb.

uses.text: The Signal Veil is fitted for one stealth approach and logged against the operation.
The Coherence Nail is checked against the retreat plan before anyone carries it outward.

room_features.name: Archive Relay Aperture
room_features.look: A dark radial gate sits between two evidence vaults with an empty keyed decoder socket.
room_features.search: The gate can retain a commissioned calibration after the portable key is removed.

uses.text: The Archive Cipher commissions both directions of the Echo Observatory route and records the source chain.

room_features.name: Parzival Testimony
room_features.look: One recording is preserved beside three visible gaps and an unaltered timing trace.
room_features.search: The surviving intervals point toward Meme Farm 17 without claiming what happened inside the gaps.

uses.text: The Memory Lantern separates one attributed farm-route detail from a later reconstruction.

room_features.name: Recovery Channel
room_features.look: One capsule response arrives half a beat later than the repeating terminal chorus.
room_features.search: The delayed response identifies itself as Iri Vale and asks for a consent witness before separation.

uses.text: The Loopbreaker Patch interrupts the repeating control signal long enough for Iri to answer independently.
The Consciousness Capsule is secured for an evacuation chosen by its occupant.

room_features.name: Auditor Terminal
room_features.look: The report shows prevented failures beside a shorter list of voices classified as divergence.
room_features.search: Every stability gain has a named operator, a measurable cost, and a group that did not authorize it.

uses.text: The Data Spike opens one audited maintenance path and leaves its intervention visible.
The Signal Veil crosses one observation lane without altering the report.
The Chimera Access Spine proves the alternate route is safe for construct bodies.

room_features.name: Convergence Controls
room_features.look: Three control paths are marked expose, reroute, and dismantle; none is presented as consequence-free.
room_features.search: The current alignment can be changed only by a committed group action with an attributable operator.

uses.text: The Oneirocom Reality Anchor stabilizes the chamber long enough to make one accountable choice.
The Convergence Key exposes all three authored resolution paths without selecting one.
The Data Spike records the chosen control intervention in the engine audit.

room_features.name: Green Loom Relay Aperture
room_features.look: A dormant living gate has an empty covenant bed woven through its calibration frame.
room_features.search: Once commissioned, the gate stores the covenant in its own living circuit rather than drawing power from the portable thread.

uses.text: The Green Loom Thread commissions both directions of the Signal Orchard route and records the repair covenant.

room_features.name: White Rabbit Relay Aperture
room_features.look: A patched radial receiver faces an unlit route map beyond the market roofs.
room_features.search: The receiver can retain a public route calibration without retaining the courier device.

uses.text: The White Rabbit Relay commissions both directions of the Commons route and publishes the return signal.

room_features.name: Chimera Relay Aperture
room_features.look: A broad radial gate has a construct-safe socket separated from the lab's inventory controls.
room_features.search: The route calibration can persist without retaining a spine or classifying its installer as equipment.

uses.text: The Chimera Access Spine commissions both directions of the Boneyard route under a consent-safe configuration.

room_features.name: Delta Signal Anchor Bed
room_features.look: A low teal calibration frame stands beside the largest channel junction.
room_features.search: A completed sector scan would register the channel braid without treating any one memory as the source.

room_features.name: Archive Meridian Gate
room_features.look: A coral-lit station gate faces the coldest listening bowl.

presentation.question: Can the group preserve agency while changing the convergence protocol?
presentation.situation: Attributed evidence, rescued consciousnesses, and three engine interventions remain available.
presentation.stakes: A rushed victory may replace one controlling system with another unaccountable choice.
presentation.outcome: The inner loop records an expose, reroute, or dismantle covenant and makes four relay commissions possible.
presentation.completion_memory: The group changed the convergence protocol and recorded what its liberation requires them to repair.

presentation.question: Will Oneirocom classify every unresolved signal before the group acts?
presentation.situation: The tower is converting unknowns into alignment targets.
presentation.stakes: If suppression fills, the safest engine paths close and the operation must return with a new approach.
presentation.outcome: The current intervention fails without deleting actors, NFTs, routes, or shared history.
presentation.completion_memory: Oneirocom closed the current intervention after classifying the remaining signals as suppression targets.

presentation.question: Can eight independent stations stabilize the mesh without appointing one controller?
presentation.situation: Static, spillway pressure, salvage uncertainty, and route strain are propagating through the web.
presentation.stakes: An opaque repair would make the mesh orderly but dependent on whoever owns its controls.
presentation.outcome: Four disclosed interventions stabilize the web while leaving its many paths legible.
presentation.completion_memory: Residents stabilized the perimeter as a shared mesh with public returns and repair duties.

presentation.question: Will one failing route teach the whole mesh to fail?
presentation.situation: Unattributed control signals are coupling static, water, salvage, and weather pressure.
presentation.stakes: A cascade closes the current repair window and scatters its evidence across generated paths.
presentation.outcome: The mesh remains traversable, but the communal stabilization attempt must begin again.
presentation.completion_memory: The perimeter cascade outpaced the current repair plan without deleting its routes or residents.

presentation.question: Can four distant stations promise exploration, maintenance, consent, and return at the same time?
presentation.situation: Each station holds one necessary term of a frontier charter and one tool another station needs.
presentation.stakes: A weak charter turns infinity into abandonment; a controlling charter makes departure another permission.
presentation.outcome: The four stations publish a durable open-circuit charter before future forks appear.
presentation.completion_memory: The stations chartered an infinite frontier around visible maintenance and an attended return.

presentation.question: Will the four stations drift into private frontiers before they agree how to return?
presentation.situation: Long distances are turning local practices into incompatible rules.
presentation.stakes: If drift fills, each station begins charging a different social price for passage.
presentation.outcome: The circuit remains open, but its common charter must be rebuilt from four local compacts.
presentation.completion_memory: Frontier drift divided the stations' rules without erasing the long routes between them.

jobs.premise: Oneirocom is tightening incompatible signals into a convergence protocol while trapped consciousnesses and constructs remain classified as resources.
jobs.stakes: The group must change the engine without erasing the differences it came to liberate.

reward.label: the inner loop liberated and four two-stage relay routes commissionable

jobs.consequence: the current intervention closes and must be approached again through the surviving loop
jobs.memory_summary: Travelers attributed the evidence, recovered independent witnesses, and confronted the convergence protocol.

action_copy.label: Resolve Operation Liberation
action_copy.summary: Bring attributed evidence and an accountable control approach to the Convergence Engine.

narrated_thresholds.text: Oneirocom classifies two uncertain routes and publishes the operators responsible.
The engine tightens its alignment window, leaving less room for an untested intervention.
A final warning names the signals that will be contained if the group delays again.

jobs.premise: Four different failures are coupling across the amorphous relay web while every station depends on another resident's portable expertise.
jobs.stakes: The residents must stabilize a public mesh without flattening it into one centrally controlled route.

reward.label: a stable public mesh and eight honored exchanges

jobs.consequence: the present repair window closes while the authored web and its residents remain available
jobs.memory_summary: The perimeter residents exchanged portable expertise and repaired four coupled failures without centralizing the web.

action_copy.label: Stabilize the perimeter
action_copy.summary: Complete disclosed interventions at the Delta, Gardens, Spillway, and Boneyard.

jobs.premise: Four distant stations must agree what exploration owes to maintenance, consent, evidence, and return before the engine begins growing forks.
jobs.stakes: The frontier should become infinite without becoming ownerless, privately gated, or centrally controlled.

reward.label: the published Open Circuit Charter and a funded first expedition

jobs.consequence: the stations keep their circuit but negotiate the next charter from four incompatible local rules
jobs.memory_summary: Four stations exchanged their portable authorities and chartered exploration around an attended return.

action_copy.label: Charter the open circuit
action_copy.summary: Carry each station's necessary instrument to the station that can turn it into a public term.

fronts.premise: The Convergence Voice is converting unresolved people, routes, and memories into alignment targets under Oneirocom authority.
stakes_questions: Can useful stability survive without one authority defining acceptable reality?
Will recovered consciousnesses and constructs retain the right to choose where they go?
fronts.impending_outcome: Oneirocom closes the current intervention and requires every unresolved signal to return through a controlled intake.

fronts.premise: Four local failures are teaching the relay web to amplify pressure faster than its residents can attribute it.
stakes_questions: Can the mesh remain amorphous without becoming unknowable?
Will residents exchange expertise without surrendering custody of their tools?
fronts.impending_outcome: The current repair window collapses and the next attempt must recover evidence from the generated paths.

fronts.premise: Distance is turning four station customs into mutually incompatible rules for the same open circuit.
stakes_questions: Can an infinite frontier keep a finite duty of care?
Who attends the return when every station wants to explore?
fronts.impending_outcome: Four private station rules replace the common charter while the long circuit remains traversable.

conditions.name: Blinded
conditions.source_text: While you have the Blinded condition, you experience the following effects. Can't See. You can't see and automatically fail any ability check that requires sight. Attacks Affected. Attack rolls against you have Advantage, and your attack rolls have Disadvantage.

conditions.name: Charmed
conditions.source_text: While you have the Charmed condition, you experience the following effects. Can't Harm the Charmer. You can't attack the charmer or target the charmer with damaging abilities or magical effects. Social Advantage. The charmer has Advantage on any ability check to interact with you socially.

conditions.name: Deafened
conditions.source_text: While you have the Deafened condition, you experience the following effect. Can't Hear. You can't hear and automatically fail any ability check that requires hearing.

conditions.name: Exhaustion
conditions.source_text: While you have the Exhaustion condition, you experience the following effects. Exhaustion Levels. This condition is cumulative. Each time you receive it, you gain 1 Exhaustion level. You die if your Exhaustion level is 6. D20 Tests Affected. When you make a D20 Test, the roll is reduced by 2 times your Exhaustion level. Speed Reduced. Your Speed is reduced by a number of feet equal to 5 times your Exhaustion level. Removing Exhaustion Levels. Finishing a Long Rest removes 1 of your Exhaustion levels. When your Exhaustion level reaches 0, the condition ends.

conditions.name: Frightened
conditions.source_text: While you have the Frightened condition, you experience the following effects. Ability Checks and Attacks Affected. You have Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls while the source of fear is within line of sight. Can't Approach. You can't willingly move closer to the source of fear.

conditions.name: Grappled
conditions.source_text: While you have the Grappled condition, you experience the following effects. Speed 0. Your Speed is 0 and can't increase. Attacks Affected. You have Disadvantage on attack rolls against any target other than the grappler. Movable. The grappler can drag or carry you when it moves, but every foot of movement costs it 1 extra foot unless you are Tiny or two or more sizes smaller than it.

conditions.name: Incapacitated
conditions.source_text: While you have the Incapacitated condition, you experience the following effects. Inactive. You can't take any action, Bonus Action, or Reaction. No Concentration. Your Concentration is broken. Speechless. You can't speak. Surprised. If you're Incapacitated when you roll Initiative, you have Disadvantage on the roll.

conditions.name: Invisible
conditions.source_text: While you have the Invisible condition, you experience the following effects. Surprise. If you're Invisible when you roll Initiative, you have Advantage on the roll. Concealed. You aren't affected by any effect that requires its target to be seen unless the effect's creator can somehow see you. Any equipment you are wearing or carrying is also concealed. Attacks Affected. Attack rolls against you have Disadvantage, and your attack rolls have Advantage. If a creature can somehow see you, you don't gain this benefit against that creature.

conditions.name: Paralyzed
conditions.source_text: While you have the Paralyzed condition, you experience the following effects. Incapacitated. You have the Incapacitated condition. Speed 0. Your Speed is 0 and can't increase. Saving Throws Affected. You automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saving throws. Attacks Affected. Attack rolls against you have Advantage. Automatic Critical Hits. Any attack roll that hits you is a Critical Hit if the attacker is within 5 feet of you.

conditions.name: Petrified
conditions.source_text: While you have the Petrified condition, you experience the following effects. Turned to Inanimate Substance. You are transformed, along with any nonmagical objects you are wearing and carrying, into a solid inanimate substance (usually stone). Your weight increases by a factor of ten, and you cease aging. Incapacitated. You have the Incapacitated condition. Speed 0. Your Speed is 0 and can't increase. Attacks Affected. Attack rolls against you have Advantage. Saving Throws Affected. You automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saving throws. Resist Damage. You have Resistance to all damage. Poison Immunity. You have Immunity to the Poisoned condition.

conditions.name: Poisoned
conditions.source_text: While you have the Poisoned condition, you experience the following effect. Ability Checks and Attacks Affected. You have Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

conditions.name: Prone
conditions.source_text: While you have the Prone condition, you experience the following effects. Restricted Movement. Your only movement options are to crawl or to spend an amount of movement equal to half your Speed (round down) to right yourself and thereby end the condition. If your Speed is 0, you can't right yourself. Attacks Affected. You have Disadvantage on attack rolls. An attack roll against you has Advantage if the attacker is within 5 feet of you. Otherwise, that attack roll has Disadvantage.

conditions.name: Restrained
conditions.source_text: While you have the Restrained condition, you experience the following effects. Speed 0. Your Speed is 0 and can't increase. Attacks Affected. Attack rolls against you have Advantage, and your attack rolls have Disadvantage. Saving Throws Affected. You have Disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws.

conditions.name: Stunned
conditions.source_text: While you have the Stunned condition, you experience the following effects. Incapacitated. You have the Incapacitated condition. Saving Throws Affected. You automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saving throws. Attacks Affected. Attack rolls against you have Advantage.

conditions.name: Unconscious
conditions.source_text: While you have the Unconscious condition, you experience the following effects. Inert. You have the Incapacitated and Prone conditions, and you drop whatever you're holding. When this condition ends, you remain Prone. Speed 0. Your Speed is 0 and can't increase. Attacks Affected. Attack rolls against you have Advantage. Saving Throws Affected. You automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saving throws. Automatic Critical Hits. Any attack roll that hits you is a Critical Hit if the attacker is within 5 feet of you. Unaware. You're unaware of your surroundings.

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.description: The dryad has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

features.name: Speak with Beasts and Plants
features.description: The dryad can communicate with Beasts and Plants as if they shared a language.

features.name: Multiattack
features.description: The dryad makes one Vine Lash or Thorn Burst attack, and it can use Spellcasting to cast Charm Monster.

features.name: Vine Lash
features.description: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 10 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) Slashing damage.

features.name: Thorn Burst
features.description: Ranged Attack Roll: +6, range 60 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) Piercing damage.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: The dryad casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14): At Will: Animal Friendship, Charm Monster (lasts 24 hours; ends early if the dryad casts the spell again), Druidcraft. 1/Day Each: Entangle, Pass without Trace.

features.name: Tree Stride
features.description: If within 5 feet of a Large or bigger tree, the dryad teleports to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of a second Large or bigger tree that is within 60 feet of the previous tree.

features.name: Needle Sword
features.description: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) Piercing damage.

features.name: Enchanting Bow
features.description: Ranged Attack Roll: +6, range 40/160 ft. Hit: 1 Piercing damage, and the target has the Charmed condition until the start of the sprite's next turn.

features.name: Heart Sight
features.description: Charisma Saving Throw: DC 10, one creature within 5 feet the sprite can see (Celestials, Fiends, and Undead automatically fail the save). Failure: The sprite knows the target's emotions and alignment.

features.name: Invisibility
features.description: The sprite casts Invisibility on itself, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability.

features.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
features.description: If the unicorn fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.description: The unicorn has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

features.name: Multiattack
features.description: The unicorn makes one Hooves attack and one Radiant Horn attack.

features.name: Hooves
features.description: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.

features.name: Radiant Horn
features.description: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) Radiant damage.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: The unicorn casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14): At Will: Detect Evil and Good, Druidcraft. 1/Day Each: Calm Emotions, Dispel Evil and Good, Entangle, Pass without Trace, Word of Recall.

features.name: Unicorn's Blessing (3/Day)
features.description: The unicorn touches another creature with its horn and casts Cure Wounds or Lesser Restoration on that creature, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

features.name: Charging Horn
features.description: The unicorn moves up to half its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks, and it makes one Radiant Horn attack.

features.name: Shimmering Shield
features.description: The unicorn targets itself or one creature it can see within 60 feet of itself. The target gains 10 (3d6) Temporary Hit Points, and its AC increases by 2 until the end of the unicorn's next turn. The unicorn can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

notices.title: Project 89 prototype notice
notices.text:
# Project 89 prototype notice

This pack is an implementation prototype derived from public Project 89
materials and the linked Project 89 portal. Its new prose, residents, faction
details, mechanics, and topology are CosyWorld design proposals rather than
claims about approved Project 89 canon.

Distribution, permanent voice, and production art require confirmation from
the relevant Project 89 rights holders. The pack does not grant rights in
Project 89 names, lore, NFT media, or collection assets.

The Agent Memory Seed is deliberately not a seeded item. It must be created by
the future wallet-backed actor materialization capability and follow the
corresponding asset custody receipt.

notices.title: Project 89 prototype notice
notices.text:
# Project 89 prototype notice

The four frontier stations and their ecologies are tentative CosyWorld
worldpack material. The present runtime can materialize the four authored
89-segment trunks. Persistent forks from those trunks remain an explicit
future runtime capability.

provenance.author: Cenetex
provenance.modification_notice: This bridge contains only composition-owned routes; progression is driven by authored item-installation lifecycle effects.

changes: sanctuary actions cannot create combat stakes
combat is bounded and nonlethal
skill proficiency is supplied by equipped skill charms
advancement unlocks loadout slots rather than granting items
the action hand is a projection of the legal action superset
Only authored frontier combat is legal; resolution is nonlethal and server-authored.
Ordinary room travel is an operation, not Dash.
Escape is a bounded combat operation until engagement consequences exist.
Dodge supplies bounded project preparation instead of the complete SRD duration model.
Help advances an authored project or bond with an explicit recipient.
No hidden-state resolver is active in profile 1.
Only authored bounded cooperation changes use Influence; ordinary Chat remains communication.
Only prepared item-card effects with validated descriptors can create Magic offers.
Prepare creates one authored, scoped, consumable setup tag rather than a general reaction trigger.
Perceptual discovery defaults to Wisdom and preserves learn-once claims.
Analytical discovery defaults to Intelligence and preserves learn-once claims.
Utilize requires an authored item or room-feature target and validated effect descriptor.
